title: WTShiftBench: a problem-solving benchmark protocol for endpoint-aligned auditing of transcriptomic perturbation model outputs
description: WTShiftBench is a problem-solving benchmark protocol for endpoint-aligned auditing of transcriptomic perturbation model outputs. This release includes code, source-data manifests, governed benchmark registries, active figure-panel source data, artifact hashes, scripts and documentation for reproducing the active Figure 1-4 and Extended Data Figure 1-6 panel bundle. The release does not include manuscripts, cover letters, submission packages, unpublished biological materials or private human-subject data.
